title: Storyboard director
summary: Plan general or specialized multi-shot work from owned references, review individual results and assemble an editable sequence.
author: Viral Hit contributors

inputs.label: Creative intent
inputs.description: Audience, format, desired duration and what to preserve or change.

stages.title: Plan shots
stages.description: Inspect source media and author explicit observations, directions and recipe inputs.

stages.title: Generate selected shots
stages.description: Use stable requests and inspect real results before acceptance.

stages.title: Build an editable sequence
stages.description: Prepare accepted shots and attach with the current timeline revision, then export and review.
